messages:
maria: Heads-up — CI perf alert for int8 run after merge of PR #4122 (feature/kvcache-prefetch). runtime-perf/int8-smoke shows ~18% p99 token latency regression on decode. flamegraph: https://perf.internal/r/1768/deq-hotpath

aj: Thanks, can you paste the CI job link and a short repro command?

maria: CI: https://ci.internal/builds/4221/runtime-perf/int8-smoke — failing step prints a higher p99 and a diff of time-per-token. Quick repro I used locally:
```bash
./scripts/run_perf.sh --model=gpt-small --quant=int8 --iters=200 --batch=1
```
I reproduced similar numbers locally.

devon: Any obvious hotspot from perf? flamegraphs usually point to dequant hotloop or KV lookup.

maria: Profile top lines (perf record -> annotate) — short excerpt:
```
 % cumulative   self              name
 45.2%       45.2%  0.45s  dequantize_int8
 12.1%       57.3%  0.12s  kv_cache_lookup
 10.0%       67.3%  0.10s  memcpy
  7.8%       75.1%  0.08s  pack_unroll
```
Looks like dequantize_int8 increased CPU time and now does extra branch/memmove compared to pre-merge.

aj: I can bisect the merge range. Plan: bisect between commit a1b2c3..HEAD to find the offending commit. Running perf harness in CI to speed up.

ci-bot: CI alert: runtime-perf/int8-smoke failed on merge commit d4e5f6 (PR 4122). See console: https://ci.internal/builds/4221/console

devon: If this is indeed prefetch-related, can we gate the prefetching behavior behind a runtime flag so we can roll forward safely? Also consider fallback to previous prefetch algorithm.

maria: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: set env KVCACHE_PREFETCH=off for canary. Longer-term: fix memmove alignment in dequantize path.

aj: Bisect update — culprit commit identified: 2f7a9cb (kvcache: change prefetch align + reorder memmove). Reproducer and perf diff attached to the bisect job.

devon: Nice find. Two options: revert 2f7a9cb immediately or patch the memmove to use aligned copies and avoid cross-cacheline writes. Which is faster to land?

maria: Revert probably fastest for customer impact. I'll open a revert PR and add a test that runs a minimal int8 decode perf micro to catch this. Also adding a telemetry counter for cross-cacheline memmoves.

aj: I ran quick micro with and without revert — numbers back to baseline with the revert. Will add CI gate to prevent similar reorderings without perf approval.

ops-bot: Rolling canary back in us-west-2 — previous revision restored.

maria: Thanks team — opening revert PR now (https://git.internal/r/rep/PR-4210). Follow-ups: patch aligned copies + add perf unit to pre-merge checks.

devon: Postmortem note: prefetch change improved steady-state throughput for some seq lengths but regressed decode latency due to dequant memmove ordering. We'll document tradeoffs in the quantization playbook.

aj: Closing loop: will add a short entry in the rollout checklist and a perf smoke for int8 dequant path. :thumbsup:
